Q1: What should happen to `shubhodeep1/tele-funtoken-msg-scoring`, whose AI wrappers were all switched off by hand?
Choices:
A. Retire it: remove `shubhodeep1/tele-funtoken-msg-scoring` from `.github/ai/consumer_repos.json` in one small PR. Stable-release dispatches, secret backfill, retro fan-out and the daily health check will stop covering it, and the health check will close this issue on its next run.
B. Keep it registered; the pause is intentional or temporary. No change in this repository. An operator turns the wrappers back on in the consumer repo when the pause ends, and the daily health check then closes this issue. If you choose this, close or leave this issue without implementing anything. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Keep it registered, and also add a code change so the clarify and plan workflows skip `ai:consumer-health` notice issues, the way they skip `ai:retro` and `ai:security-audit`. That stops future health notices from starting pipeline runs. **Note:** this only adds the skip; it does not retire the repo, so combine it with A only if you want both changes. Answer `A+C` for that.
